entries.0a41c8471fbda508: Living-related information on jobs and housing
entries.114cd2a904726924: Founded in 1979 in Takamatsu, Kagawa Prefecture, as a publisher of job information magazines, the company is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
entries.2aa6cf26b99cf8f0: It provides job websites, recruitment management systems, housing information services and other offerings, and earns advertising fees from companies and fees for its services.
entries.2d5f6f86aa12e524: It provides lifestyle-related information, centered on housing information.
entries.303eb48e5db6d7f6: As its immediate challenges, it cites two points: deepening and diversifying its digital marketing strategy, and strengthening its talent recruitment and training systems. In HR solution-related information, it says it will accelerate the rollout of new services, and in living-related information, it will accelerate the expansion of Ie-zukuri Gakkō and pursue approaches to new areas.
entries.32dfea16afb162a3: It provides living-related information such as job and housing information through print media, including information magazines, and through internet services, including its own job site “ARPA” and the rental property search service “Chintai Style”.
entries.3c99e1353c65f064: As the shift from print media to internet services accelerates, the company maintains its earnings while adapting to changes in how customers are acquired, through collaboration between its own job site and major portal sites and through improvements in conversion efficiency that exceed the decline in search-driven traffic.
entries.4bf058c5489403ce: The company provides HR solution-related information centered on job information. In addition to linking its own job site "ARPA" with major portal sites, it develops the recruitment management system "Arpa Connect" and the spot work matching app "ARPALINK," and also conducts staffing services and fee-based job placement at "Shigoto Keikaku Gakko." Subsidiary Appealcom Co., Ltd. also provides HR solution-related information in Ube City, Yamaguchi Prefecture. Sales results in the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥1,100,001,000 plus ¥7,000,000.
entries.4d4b58d13ec8e22f: Companies recruiting, job seekers, and individuals considering building or buying a home use its advertising and its consultation and referral services.

entries.731c66d7de536250: It provides HR solutions-related information, centered on job listing information.
entries.7cbf6ad449208dca: The company provides lifestyle-related information centered on housing information. It operates "Ie-zukuri Gakko," a consultation and referral service that supports home building, with a structure of 16 schools combining physical schools and online schools, and also provides "Chintai Style," a rental property search service. Sales results in the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥1,100,002,000 plus ¥1,000,000.
